$comment: Advisories that have been read, judged against how this system is actually deployed, and accepted until the review date. An entry here is a decision somebody made, not a way to make the build quiet: the audit gate fails once reviewBy has passed, so an acceptance cannot rot.

accepted.title: invalid content-type parsing could lead to validation bypass
accepted.why: Reaches a body that has already passed an api key check, and every body on this server is parsed again by a zod schema that ignores the content type entirely. The bypass is of fastify's own schema validation, which this server does not use.

accepted.title: content-type header tab character allows body validation bypass
accepted.why: Same shape as GHSA-mg2h-6x62-wpwc and the same reasoning: validation here is zod at the handler, not a fastify body schema.

accepted.title: denial of service via unbounded memory allocation in sendWebStream
accepted.why: No handler in this server returns a web stream. Every response is a plain object or the metrics text, so the affected path is not reachable.

accepted.title: request.protocol and request.host spoofable via X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Host
accepted.why: trustProxy is off, so fastify does not read those headers at all, and nothing in this codebase reads request.protocol or request.host. The server is on the yard network behind a key rather than on the public internet.
